title: NVIDIA Form 8-K announcing definitive Hugging Face acquisition agreement
excerpt: NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for approximately $11.9 billion plus an employee retention program of up to approximately $1.0 billion.
summary: The definitive agreement may deepen NVIDIA's open-model distribution and developer ecosystem but adds integration, retention, regulatory and data-governance risk before expected closing in the first half of 2027.
